# Pramukh Pharma Tech

> Manufacturer, supplier and exporter of pharmaceutical processing machinery
> based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India — serving pharmaceutical, ayurvedic,
> cosmetic, chemical, nutraceutical and food industries, with export reach
> across global markets.

Pramukh Pharma Tech designs and manufactures GMP-compliant, stainless-steel
processing machinery: tablet presses, dryers, granulators, blenders, mills
and material handling equipment. Every machine is tested before dispatch and
backed by after-sales support through installation and training.

Contact: +91-9099908890 · pramukhpharmatech@gmail.com
Address: 66,67 – Mahaveer Industrial Park – 2, Opp. RadheKrishna Gold Estate,
Kathawada Village Road, Kathawada, Ahmedabad, Gujarat - 382430, India
